title: docs(skills): teach an object extension's `place`; another package's child list still shows on a declared tab list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WF2JA4aXQRy81L1mg6vYtR)_

Fixes #35902
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **用户能看到什么变化**:用 AI 搭建应用的人,让自己的扩展包给别人的对象加字段或子表时,AI 现在会写明它们排在哪个字段、哪个页签后面;技能和指南不再说「别的包加的子表会被隐藏」;CRM 示例的客户对象演示了页签清单和分组自己列字段。
- **为什么做**:属于「记录页的页签和字段分组改由父对象一处声明」专题:平台的四种新写法都已合并,这一批补上最后一种(扩展包声明位置)的技能、指南、评测和示例,免得「做了没人知道」。
- **出错会怎样**:AI 可能没写位置或写错,扩展包带来的字段和页签就按默认排在末尾,不丢数据;撤回只需回退这一次合并。
- **要你做什么**:批准合并这份技能与指南的更新。

## What changes

The fourth form of the parent-declared record page, an extension's `place`, reaches the skills, the guide and an eval; the sentence that said another package's child list is hidden goes; one repository example declares a tab list.

| File | Change |
|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` § Object Extension Model | `defineObjectExtension` takes `place`. One example with a field entry and a list entry, the group form `{ group: { key, label }, after }`, `before` as the other anchor, and the condition: placement applies where the target declares `fieldGroups` / `relatedLists`. |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` step 2 | "A child list another package adds is hidden by a `relatedLists` that does not name it (no package places its own list yet)" becomes "still shows, after the named lists or where its extension's `place` puts it (objectstack-data)". |
| `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` case 26, `evals/README.md` | An add-on package puts its Tax ID field after Industry in the account's Basic group and its Contracts tab after Opportunities, on an account whose tab list names another child list after Opportunities, so a missing list placement draws a different page. Expected: two `place` entries on the package's own extension, no redeclared `crm_account`, no `overrides:`. |
| `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, record page section | The same sentence corrected (shows where the extension places it, or at the end of the tabs, before approvals and the activity stream); a paragraph and a checked `defineObjectExtension` example for `place`, linking the object-extensions guide, which already documents the key. |
| `examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts` | `fieldGroups` listing each group's `fields`, and `relatedLists` naming every tab in order, one entry with its own `columns`, the two built-ins by object name. |
| `examples/app-crm/src/translations/crm.translation.ts` | zh-CN labels for the two new groups. |
| `.changeset/35902-skills-extension-place.md` | New, `@objectstack/skills` patch. |
| `.changeset/35902-skills-related-lists-tabs.md` | DELIBERATE CORRECTION, see below. |

What the skills already taught before this change, and is not in the diff: the tab list with the three built-ins, an entry's `label` / `columns`, a group's `fields`, and the group that places a child table, each with its example and its eval (record-page evals 1, 4, 5, 6), and the repository examples of a group placing a child table (the showcase invoice, the CRM example's opportunity).

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending release note.** `.changeset/35902-skills-related-lists-tabs.md` is on main and unreleased. Its first bullet said: "A child list another package adds is hidden by a `relatedLists` that does not name it." The platform change that let a package place its own list made that false before any release carried it. The sentence now reads: "A child list another package adds still shows, after the named lists or where that package's extension places it." Nothing else in the note changed. `Check Changeset` is red on this by design; no `skip-changeset`.

### Skill size readings

| | main `316f7571` | This head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 473 lines · 26,832 bytes · 6,703 tokens (ceiling 6,710) | 473 lines · 26,858 bytes · 6,710 tokens (ceiling 6,710, not raised) |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` | 64 lines · 3,952 bytes · 988 tokens (ceiling 991) | 64 lines · 3,958 bytes · 990 tokens (ceiling 991, not raised) |
| All 14 `SKILL.md` files | 4,950 lines · 261,027 bytes | 4,950 lines · 261,053 bytes |
| Ratcheted (authored) tokens | 197,533 | 197,542 |
| Eval fixtures (measured, not ratcheted) | 78,177 | 78,658 |
| `skills/**`, 114 files | 1,172,198 bytes | 1,174,155 bytes |

The data skill's entry file had 7 tokens of headroom and the `place` paragraph costs about 75, so the rest is paid in the same file by shorter wording, no ceiling moved. Every inline code span and every link of the file on main is still in it (compared by script), except the one signature that gained `place`. What the shorter wording no longer says, all prose: "on 31/31 objects in the reference apps" (twice, on `pluralLabel` and `icon`; the instruction to author both stays), "the fundamental data entity in ObjectStack", the lead-in "The full table, per-type config and traps" (the link stays), "stored and read ... on the record" in the multi-value lookup note, "range" before `0–999`, "incorrect/correct" before "examples", and "This axis is distinct from `ownership`, which decides" (now "`ownership` is a separate axis").

## Tests

- No runtime behaviour changes, so no ablation.
- **The taught shapes parse.** The skill's example, its group form, the guide's example and a `before` entry go through the built spec's `defineObjectExtension`: 4 of 4 accepted. Control leg: an entry with both `after` and `before`, and an entry with a misspelt key, are both refused, so an accept is a measurement.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`: exit 0, `349 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`, the guide's new block among them, against a spec built at this base (full build under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- **The example app.** `@objectstack/example-crm`: `typecheck` exit 0; `test` 7 files, 51 tests passed (under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`); `validate` "Validation passed", no warning.
- **Eval token reachability.** `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`: exit 0, "Every must_contain token is taught by its own skill bundle."
- **Skill evals: NOT MEASURED.** No eval round ran here. The card's "four eval cases pass" and the new case 26 are owed a round: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --skills objectstack-data,objectstack-ui`.

## Acceptance notes

1. **This slice is the card's last.** Item 5 of the card (HotCRM declares `relatedLists` on its five main objects) lives in another repository and is carried by objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2742, which the seat filed from the hand-off on the card (comment 7082792445); it waits for a release that carries these keys. Seat record: card comment 7083107636.
2. **Overlap.** `overlap-check` at this head exits 1 on two open pull requests. The draft that turns the data skill's entry file into a router, #36158, rewrites `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` whole: this pull request does not wait for it (the seat's call), and whichever lands second merges main and replays its entry-file text. If the router lands first, the `place` paragraph belongs in `references/examples-objects.md` § Object Extension Model, where that draft moves the section, and the wording payments here are dropped. The release pull request (`chore: version packages`) deletes every pending note, so a corrected pending note conflicts with it by construction; the release job regenerates it from main.
3. **A `relatedLists` entry's `label` has no translation key that I could find.** The CRM example's entries carry no `label` for that reason. Read from `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`: it has `relatedListTitle` under the child's field and `_sections` for groups, and no key for a tab-list entry's `label`. The console's reading was not traced and nothing was reproduced at run time. The seat filed the observation as #36528.
4. **The example lives in the CRM example, not the showcase.** The showcase account's record page is pinned by an end-to-end shape test, and the CRM example's account had neither key.
5. **The multi-value lookup note keeps its `{record.tags.0}` token.** The router draft above records that the automation skill refuses that token in a value slot and corrects it; this change only shortened the sentence around it.
6. **Merging ends the card while its eval done-when is unmeasured.** The round named under Tests is owed; the seat filed #36535 as its carrier, for the eval lane to run on main after the merge.
7. **Guide example.** The record page section of the guide carries the full Quote example from the parent card already; this change adds the extension half beside it.

## Verification

**Read first, by risk:**

1. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`: the payments. Risky hunk: the Object Extension Model guard, where "`extend` is not object-level `ownership`" replaced a longer sentence; the four enum values stay.
2. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` step 2: one sentence flips from "hidden" to "still shows".
3. `examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts`: the declared tab list names all four child lists, so no tab the page had is dropped.

**Two-minute check:** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`. Expected: the last line reads `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 60 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`, and the two changed rows read `6710 / 6710` and `990 / 991`.

**Head `8c346d66`**, two commits. The readings below were taken at `b9cdb233`; the second commit, from the contract review's finding S1, changes one eval fixture (the prompt's tab list and one sentence of the expected answer) and one comment in the CRM example. Re-run at `8c346d66`: `check-skills-token-ratchet` exit 0, `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` exit 0, `check-nul-bytes` exit 0, the CRM example's `typecheck` exit 0. Exit codes captured before any pipe.

**Derived list.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` printed 90 commands. All 90 ran at `b9cdb233`: 89 exit 0, 1 exit 1. The exit 1 is `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, red by design on the corrected pending note (DELIBERATE CORRECTION above); its other half reads "No empty-frontmatter changeset introduced by this diff (2 declaring changeset(s) added)".

Reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 90 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 90 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`

The dist-reading gates in that list read a full build of this tree (`pnpm build`, 13m40s, `VERDICT command-exit 0`). The build ran before the last wording edits to the two skill files and the guide; none of those files is a build input of the packages the gates read, and the gates themselves ran after the final commit.

**Outside the derived list:** `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exit 1 (Acceptance note 2); the example app's three commands and the eval-token check under Tests.

**Not run locally, CI's:** the type-check lanes, `Build Core`, `Test Core`, the repo lint, the docs build.
